title: Fake Subscription Trial
scenario: A kid’s learning app offers a free trial but hides recurring charges.

answers.A: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.B: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.C: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.
answers.D: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.

explanation: Fake Subscription Trial: the trap is to make borrowed authority feel safer than checking. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: Review subscription terms and cancel through official app stores.
